result.direction_semantics: degrees counter-clockwise from operation-frame +X, modulo 180; the direction is the horizontal trace of each near-vertical triangle plane; it is not an alignment yaw
result.evidence_caveat: These are area-weighted orientation statistics of selected mesh triangles. A bin may combine disconnected, parallel, adjacent, or differently semantic surfaces; its area share, angular concentration, and projection extent do not make it a fitted wall, a reliable wall edge, or a true coordinate axis. Use tight bounds or explicit face IDs and inspect the underlying surface evidence.

data.scope: agent-supplied geometry to independent source BIM; no correction run or solver stage

source_geometry_self_consistency.scope: source geometry, contacts and explicit opening hosts

agent_assumptions: Local construction frame is the mesh BIM-local frame rotated yaw=+8 deg about +z to axis-align the building; all coordinates are in this yawed frame (metres).
Building is a courtyard/perimeter block: L-shaped 8-storey tall mass (west wing + north/northeast bar) plus a ~2-storey low podium (~6.85m) filling the inner SE corner; far SE is open/not built.
Storeys reconciled with declaration: ground (commercial) + six similar office storeys + one setback upper storey = 8; floor-to-floor ~3.4m, ground 4.0m, main roof ~28m.
All interior partitions, corridors, cores and doors are explicit hypotheses; no interior evidence exists in the mesh.
Window rows are representative regular rhythms preserving piers between openings; exact counts/positions per bay are not surveyed.
Rooftop penthouse footprint/height approximate from mesh green roof structures (~31-34m).
unresolved: Exact footprint edge coordinates (+/- ~0.5m) and true wall thickness not resolved.
Inner courtyard-facing facades (west wing east face, north bar south face toward podium) not glazed in model; window presence there unknown.
Exact setback geometry of upper storey assumed as uniform ~2m inset.
Vertical circulation core location and stair/elevator count are hypothetical.
Precise slab levels not surveyed; storey heights inferred from ~28m cornice over 8 storeys.

mesh_frame.reason: Correcting the mesh-to-BIM registration. Seed's stated yaw=+8 deg does not axis-align the mesh: independent area-weighted near-vertical triangle direction analysis at yaw=+8 shows dominant wall directions at ~82-86 deg and ~170-178 deg (off-axis). At yaw=-76 deg the same dominant surfaces land at ~0/88/90/178/180 deg, consistent with an axis-aligned rectilinear/L-shaped footprint. Translation kept at zero pending overlay check.
